dom.scene: A compact home music studio on a rainy evening. Sitting sideways on a swivel stool, she turns her torso toward a small synthesizer to adjust a single knob with one relaxed hand while her other hand rests on her knee. Amber desk lamp and muted blue window light; no readable screens or text.
dom.outfit: A loose pale-blue sleeveless cropped camisole, white athletic shorts, navy knee-high socks, tiny spiral hair clip. Casual comfortable hobby clothing with bare shoulders, midriff and thighs; no armor.
